scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
請在這裡安心休息。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You will now end
your present life and
begin an entirely new life.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
您即將結束此生，開啟全新的人生。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
There are a few things you must
do before we start. You must
first empty your mind and body.
Honor comes when you abandon
all your selfish desires...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
開始之前，您還需要做些準備。
首先，放空身心。
捨棄一切私慾，方能獲得榮耀...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You cannot take anything with you to the next life. Your items, zeny, pets and Pushcart all have to be left behind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
您不能帶任何東西進入來世。
物品、Zeny、寵物和手推車，都必須留下。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
When you are ready
please return to me,
brave adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
勇敢的冒險者，準備好了，就回來見我。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I see you've already
released yourself from
all worldy attachments,
{0}.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
{0}，看來您已經放下所有世俗的牽絆。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
That's an admirable attitude for an adventurer such as yourself. Honor comes when you abandon all personal desires for the sake of mankind.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
身為冒險者，能有這樣的心境，令人欽佩。
為了人類捨棄一切私慾，方能獲得榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Hmm... I sense that you have
some lingering attachment or
unfinished business in your
current life. Take care of that,
and bring closure to your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
嗯...我感到您在此生還有放不下的牽絆，或尚未完成的事。
先去處理妥當，為這一生畫上句號。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Now, let me remove all
of your present memories...
However, you will be able to
remember the most honorable
moments of this life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
現在，讓我抹去您此生的記憶...
不過，最榮耀的時刻，您仍會銘記。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With one,
I will ask the
goddess Urd to remove
all of your present
memories.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
數到一，我將請求女神烏爾德，抹去您此生的記憶。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With two,
I will ask the
goddess Verdandi to keep
and record the most honorable moments of your present life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
數到二，我將請求女神薇丹蒂，保留並記錄您此生最榮耀的時刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
With three,
I will ask the
goddess Skuld to
guide you to your
next life.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
數到三，我將請求女神絲柯爾德，引領您走向來世。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
一...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......

[Valkyrie]
One...
Two......
And Three.

[Valkyrie]
Congratulations.
You are now reborn
into a brand new life.
Please take these small gifts
in preparation for your new adventures.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
恭喜。
您已經重生，開啟了全新的人生。
收下這些小禮物，為新的冒險做好準備吧。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
I wish that the release the goddess Urd has granted you proves to be a blessing. I hope that the memories Verdandi has recorded will always honor you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
願烏爾德女神賜予您的解脫，成為一份祝福。
願薇丹蒂記錄下的記憶，永遠為您帶來榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
And I pray that the new life to which the goddess Skuld will guide you will be even more honorable than your last.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
我也祈願，絲柯爾德女神引領您走向的新生，會比上一世更加榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
Unfortunately, you have not yet been invited here. I ask you to leave immediately. Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
很遺憾，您尚未受邀來到這裡，請立即離開。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I assume you have come here
to read the 'Book of Ymir.'
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
歡迎來到施瓦伊希比爾魔法學院的圖書館。
我想您是來閱讀《尤米爾之書》的。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, the original copy of the book has been damaged over time. We currently only allow the public to view a copy of the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
很遺憾，這本書的原本歷經歲月，已經受損。
目前，我們只開放副本供公眾查閱。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Also, in order to preserve the original 'Book of Ymir,' we have decided to accept donations from people who wish to read the copy we have provided.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
為了保護《尤米爾之書》的原本，我們決定向希望閱讀副本的人士募捐。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The suggested
donation amount is
1,285,000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
建議捐贈1,285,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Donate.
scripts.translation: 捐贈

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Thank you, your donation will be used for a good cause. You may
now go in and read the book.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
謝謝，您的捐款會用於有益的事業。
現在，您可以進去閱讀了。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Unfortunately, you don't seem to possess enough zeny at the moment. Please check your funds and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
很遺憾，您目前的Zeny似乎不夠。
請確認金額後再來。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Take your time, and
enjoy your travels.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
不必著急，祝您旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Once again, thank you for your generous donation. Feel free to read a carbon copy of the 'Book of Ymir' at your leisure.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
再次感謝您的慷慨捐贈。
您可以隨時閱讀《尤米爾之書》的副本。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Library of the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Here, we have a countless number of books. Please take your time and look around.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西爾菲]
歡迎來到施瓦伊希比爾魔法學院圖書館。
這裡藏書無數，請慢慢瀏覽。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...The entrance to the Hall of Honor is open to anyone who has moved forward into their next life. It is there to help heroes decide what they want to do, and can lead them to anywhere in this world.
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
...榮耀之廳的大門，向所有進入新生的人敞開。
它幫助英雄們決定今後的道路，也能引領他們前往世間的任何地方。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
In the Hall of Honor, everything is prepared for heroes. It is rumored that any wish that cannot be fulfilled in our reality can be realized in the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
榮耀之廳的一切，皆為英雄而備。
傳說，現實中無法實現的願望，都能在那裡實現。

scripts.text: Stop reading.
scripts.translation: 停止閱讀

scripts.text: Continue reading.
scripts.translation: 繼續閱讀

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
.....
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
.....

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There is a forgotten path which leads to the Hall of Honor, the closest place to the heavens. The ordinary will never discover this place...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
一條被遺忘的道路，通往最接近天界的榮耀之廳。
凡人永遠無法發現那裡...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...Therefore, ancient heroes were
always in anguish, knowing that
eventually, they were mortal and
would pass from this realm...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
...因此，古代英雄常懷憂慮，因為他們深知自己終究是凡人，難逃一死，終將離開這個世界...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
There were no documents,
songs, or remaining folklore that had any information on life after death. However, I recently uncovered an old scroll
about Valkyrie...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
無論文獻、歌謠，還是流傳至今的民間傳說，都沒有關於死後世界的記載。
不過，我最近發現了一卷有關瓦爾基里的古老卷軸...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Valkyrie...
The legendary
guardian angel.
Angel of Ragnarok.
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
瓦爾基里...
傳說中的守護天使。
諸神黃昏的天使。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Adventurers of great strength
and bravery will be lead by
Valkyrie to Valhalla, the Hall
of Honor. There, they will be
given a new life.
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
力量強大、勇氣過人的冒險者，將由瓦爾基里引領，前往榮耀之廳——英靈殿。
在那裡，他們將獲得新生。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Reborn, they will live again as
even greater heroes that will
brighten the world. Bodies that
were exhausted will be filled
with energy...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
重生之後，他們將成為更偉大的英雄，為世界帶來光明。
疲憊的身軀，也將重新充滿力量...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
And their souls will be given abilities with the heart of Ymir. However, the heart of Ymir was totally destroyed and scattered all over the world after the battle for Rune-Midgarts.
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
他們的靈魂，將獲得尤米爾之心賦予的力量。
然而，盧恩·米德加茲之戰後，尤米爾之心已被徹底摧毀，碎片散落於世界各地。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
I have found a small amount of
Ymir heart pieces over a long
long period of time. But I can't
confirm if the story of Valkyrie
and Valhalla is true just
through scientific tests.
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
經過漫長歲月，我找到了少量尤米爾之心碎片。
但僅憑科學測試，仍無法證實瓦爾基里與英靈殿的傳說是否真實。

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
So, I am leaving this record in hope that someone in the future
can confirm that Valkyrie and Valhalla actually exist...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
因此，我留下這份記錄，希望未來有人能證實瓦爾基里和英靈殿確實存在...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
Let the heroes live new lives
so they can protect the world
from danger. And then...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
讓英雄們獲得新生，守護世界免遭危難。
然後...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
...

scripts.text:
[The Book of Ymir]
...
scripts.translation:
[尤米爾之書]
...

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Congratulations.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[傳送員]
恭喜您。
向勇士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Please refrain
from touching any
of the exhibitions.
..........
scripts.translation:
[傳送員]
請勿觸控任何展品。
..........

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Honorable one,
which place do you wish to go?
scripts.translation:
[傳送員]
尊貴的勇士，您想去哪裡？

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 夢羅克

scripts.text: Payon
scripts.translation: 斐揚

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾爾貝塔

scripts.text: Izlude
scripts.translation: 依斯魯得島

scripts.text: Al De Baran
scripts.translation: 艾爾帕蘭

scripts.text: Comodo
scripts.translation: 克魔島

scripts.text: Juno
scripts.translation: 朱諾

scripts.text:
[Teleporter]
Have a nice trip.
scripts.translation:
[傳送員]
祝您旅途愉快。
